title: AnalyzeResponseData
description: Session payload peer-connections, observations and scores.

userAgentData.description: Browser, platform, hardware and screen information.

pConnectionsNumber.description: Number of RTCPeerConnections observed during the session.

pConnections.description: Per-PeerConnection details keyed by peer connection id.

streams.description: Peer-stream metrics (audio, video, data) keyed by stream id.

transports.description: ICE transport and candidate-pair information per PeerConnection.

aggregatedStats.description: Session-wide aggregated metrics with self-describing keys <metric>_<scope>_<agg>_<unit>: metric = jitter|rtt|bitrate|packetLoss|mos; scope = in_audio|out_audio|in_video|out_video; agg = avg|min|max|p5|p95|stddev; unit = ms (jitter, rtt), kbps (bitrate), percent (packetLoss), score (mos, 0-4.5, where 0 means unusable transport). Example: rtt_out_audio_avg_ms. Session-level weighted averages: jitter_avg_ms, rtt_avg_ms. Stream counts: in_audio_count, out_audio_count, in_video_count, out_video_count. Since schema 6.9 the former unitless keys (e.g. rtt_out_audio, in_audio) are no longer present.

connectivity.description: Resolved connectivity type for the session.

connectionIPType.description: IP family of the selected connection. Absent when it could not be resolved.

title.description: Human-readable session title (often derived from the call URL).

fileName.description: Internal name of the stored dump file.

fileSize.description: Size of the uploaded dump in bytes.

experienceScore.description: Overall experience score (0-100). 0 when there is no media data to score against.

audioScore.description: Audio quality score (1-5). Null when no audio stream is present.

videoScore.description: Video quality score (1-5). Null when no video stream is present.

connectivityScore.description: Connectivity score (1-5). Null when no peer connection produced a connectivity score (e.g. no valid candidate pair).

observationsScore.description: Aggregated severity score derived from observations. Maximum (40) when no observations were produced; lower as severity penalties are applied.

tagClouds.description: Tag-cloud entries derived from the session.

severity.description: Optional severity bucket for the tag.

created_at.description: Row creation timestamp. Null on `POST /analyze` without `?save=true` (the dump is not persisted).

uploaded_by.description: Identifier of the account/user that uploaded the dump. Null on `POST /analyze` without `?save=true`.

uploaded_by_email.description: Email of the uploader. Null on `POST /analyze` without `?save=true`.

public_link.description: Share token for the public viewer.

tags.description: User-defined tags attached to the session.

observations.description: Detected issues and insights. Each entry is an observation with a type, a severity, a category, a source object identifying what it concerns, and optional supporting values/indicators.

type.description: Observation type key, e.g. 'turnNoConfig', 'unusedStream', 'framesDropped'. The full catalog (with possible severities and tags) is available from GET /v1.0/observations.

source.description: Identifies what the observation concerns. Which properties are present depends on the category (connections: pid; pairs: pid+cpid; streams: pid+sid+ssrcId; datachannels: pid+sid; devices: did+rid+timestamp+labelId; logs: pid). Routing/matching uses pid/sid/cpid/did+timestamp; ssrcId and labelId are display identifiers.

sid.description: Stream or datachannel report id (the W3C stats report dictionary id).

rid.description: Device row index, as a string.

timestamp.description: Device entry time, an ISO-like date string.

label.description: DEPRECATED, removed in the next schema version. Overloaded legacy identifier whose runtime type is polymorphic: a number (the numeric SSRC) for stream observations, a string (the datachannel report id) for datachannels, a string (the device name) for device observations. No fixed type is declared because the runtime type varies by category. Read source.ssrcId / source.sid / source.labelId instead.

tags.description: Tags attached to the observation (e.g. network, audio, video, connectivity, security).

url.description: Related URL when applicable (e.g. the TURN server URL).

firstSeenAt.description: Epoch timestamp (ms) of the first occurrence of the observation, truncated to a whole millisecond.

valueInCount.description: Observation value as a count (e.g. number of duplicated lines or occurrences).

averageInMs.description: Average value in milliseconds (e.g. jitter, rtt, encode/decode time).

valueInPercent.description: Observation value as a percentage (e.g. audio/video loss, frames dropped).

durationInPercent.description: Duration of the observation as a percentage of the call.

durationInMs.description: Duration in milliseconds (e.g. TURN/STUN delay, signaling time).

indicators.description: Supporting indicators (e.g. min, max, average, stddev).

meaning.description: Human-readable meaning of the observation (used by the AI summary).

property.description: The specific property the observation refers to (e.g. audioLevel).

features.description: Boolean and value flags about devices, network and capabilities used during the session.

observationsCount.description: Counts of observations grouped by severity (critical, high, medium, low, info).

aiSummary.description: AI-generated session summary. Always `null` on `POST /analyze` responses and while background generation is pending or plan-gated. Stable `summary` fields: `highlight`, `network`, `media`, `user` (markdown strings) and `networkScore`, `mediaScore`, `userScore` (one of excellent, good, acceptable, poor, bad, mediocre). Other fields may appear and are subject to change without notice. Use them with care.

model.description: Model id used for generation (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5).

summary.description: AI-authored summary. Extra undocumented fields may appear and are subject to change.

networkScore.description: Qualitative network rating: excellent, good, acceptable, poor, bad or mediocre.

mediaScore.description: Qualitative media rating (same values as networkScore).

userScore.description: Qualitative user-side rating (same values as networkScore).

version.description: AI prompt configuration version used for generation.
